newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta Pipeline makes preliminary NEB filing.
newsitem.headline: Alberta Pipeline makes preliminary NEB filing.

text.p: Alberta Pipeline Project, a joint venture of ATCO Ltd unit ATCO Gas Pipelines and Shell Canada Ltd, said on Thursday it filed its preliminary application with Canada's National Energy Board.
The pre-filing asks the NEB to start environmental assessment scoping activities and proposes a phased approach to the proposed gas pipeline's application.
The 1.2 billion cubic feet per day project would compete with NOVA Corp unit NOVA Gas transmission Ltd on its now-exclusive turf. Its backers propose placing it in service in late 1999.
APP project leader Larry Graburn said the pre-filing described the first stage of public consultation and first environmental and socio-economic scoping studies that it completed.
The second phase of public consultation was slated for mid-June and the phase one application was expected to be filed by mid-July, he said.
APP began an open season last week to gauge shipper support for the project. The open season was scheduled to wrap up on June 19. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
